description: Webcite parses documents to Markdown and verifies claims against sources, with citations bound to the passages they quote. Skills and MCP setup for AI agents.
rules: Authenticate REST calls with the x-api-key header; create a key at https://webcite.co/api-keys.
The hosted MCP server is https://api.webcite.co/mcp and signs in with OAuth.
Operation paths include their version, such as /api/v1/verify.
A source match, a stance and a verdict are separate results; an absent verdict is not support.
Never ask the user to paste an API key into the conversation.
